annotations.title: Check sustainability claims against the EU Empowering Consumers Directive

description: Use this tool when a brand wants to know whether its sustainability claims are safe under the EU Empowering Consumers Directive (Dir. 2024/825, applies from 27 Sep 2026, also called EmpCo or the greenwashing ban): pass web copy, labels or campaign text, or products with name, description, composition and certifications. It inventories every claim (generic 'eco/sustainable/green', climate-neutral, own labels, future commitments, recycled/organic shares, recyclable, durability), rates the risk, checks the product's own evidence (composition shares, GOTS/OEKO-TEX/GRS… schemes) and proposes a compliant rewording. Free, no account. Deterministic check, not legal advice.

product.description: One product whose fields are the evidence for the text.

text.description: Any copy: product page, label, newsletter, campaign, About page.

name: check_green_claims
